entries.section: 6.4 Completing Office RA – Part B (Hazard Assessment), Method 1: Add Hazards from Database
entries.what_the_parse_missed: the six hazard category tabs and the three callouts of the 'Select Applicable Hazards' pop-up; the saved agentic parse reduced them to 'screenshot: Select Applicable Hazards pop-up window with categories like Work Environment and Equipment, and a list of hazards and possible incidents with checkboxes'.
entries.text:
Figure 15 — 'Select Applicable Hazards' pop-up (multiple selection; the selections are added to the RA form):
* Hazard categories (tabs): 1. Work Environment · 2. Equipment · 3. Programs/ Procedures · 4. Processes (Act) · 5. People · 6. Organization.
* Under a category the hazards are listed in groups (for example '1. Weather & Sea Conditions' under Work Environment: Vessel's Motion – Rolling & Pitching, Pounding; Sea Spray/ Shipping seas on deck; Strong winds; Low Ambient Temperatures).
* Select the applicable hazard(s), then select the Possible Incident(s) for them.
* Click 'Save' to add the selections to the RA form ('Back' returns without adding).
